ядра.ядро_en: On the Gemini API, if you use Gemini Nano Banana and need to generate a lot of images, you can use the Batch API to get higher rate limits in exchange for a turnaround of up to 24 hours.

модели_различия.текст_en: Gemini API: generic 'Gemini Nano Banana', the section's code uses gemini-3-pro-image-preview (E-10-18); Agent Platform: batch is supported by all four image models (E-58-9, E-58-10, E-58-15).

оговорки.текст_en: On Agent Platform, batch jobs are asynchronous and not designed for real-time applications; most jobs complete within 24 hours after they start running (not counting queue time), and after 24 hours incomplete jobs are cancelled and you are only charged for completed requests.
On the Gemini API, batch job creation is not idempotent: sending the same creation request twice creates two separate batch jobs.
On Agent Platform, batch inference jobs can be cancelled at any time; remaining work is cancelled, already completed work is returned and only completed work is charged.

приёмы.текст_en: Take advantage of the cost savings of batch processing for any tasks that don't require an immediate response; monitor job status and check error messages if a job fails.
Do not resend a batch creation request on uncertainty — sending the same creation request twice creates two separate batch jobs.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: A batch of dozens or hundreds of images whose results can wait for hours (a catalog, a dataset, a week of posts).
ядра.не_применяется_когда: The user is waiting for the image now (chat, mini app) — a regular Standard call is needed.

термины.значение_en: Batch completion time — up to 24 hours.
